definitions.full: H153. edra אֶדְרַע (K § 60, l )) noun [feminine] force (properly arm , ᵑ7 (rare); Biblical Hebrew אֶזְרוֺעַ ); — absolute ׳בְּא וְחָ֑יִל Ezra 4:23 by force and power , forcibly.
